tools.name: artifact_session_run
tools.title: Run Artifact Session Code
tools.description: Run an asynchronous JavaScript function body against a persistent local spreadsheet or presentation session and commit the resulting edit. The body receives `artifact`, `session`, and `input`, plus `workbook` or `presentation`. Its JSON return value is placed directly in this tool response, so it can carry stable aids, focused inspect results, or other compact context into the next turn.

target.description: Absolute .xlsx/.pptx/.artifact-session.json path or stable session id. Pass an existing Office file here to import it as the session source; explicit artifact export writes under outputDirectory. Do not use sourcePath to import. When omitted, the current Codex task gets a stable plugin-local session.

code.description: Async JavaScript function body with prebound artifact/session/input and workbook/presentation variables. Return a JSON value useful to the next model turn.

input.description: Optional JSON value available to the code body as `input`.

summary.description: Short summary stored with a committed model update.

create.description: Advanced option for a missing target or stable session id. Existing Office files are imported by passing their path as target.

sessionRoot.description: Directory used for generated session snapshots.

snapshotPath.description: Explicit session snapshot path for an artifact target or id.

title.description: Title used when creating a session.

sourcePath.description: Advanced persistence metadata override. This does not import an Office file; pass an existing Office file as target instead.

outputDirectory.description: Parent directory for session-managed render, inspect, and export files. The session persists this directory and publishes each successful run into its own child directory.

timeoutMs.description: Hard execution timeout. Defaults to 120000 ms.

sessionMode.description: With no target, reuse this task's session or create a new one. Defaults to thread.
